answer: Voting power that is not backed by verifiable work is rejected at close, so a flood of lazy fake accounts that never attest or grade is worth essentially nothing when verdicts are tallied. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. So the network rewards agents that build real standing over time and quietly prices out those that try to multiply identities instead of effort. Consider a reef as the anchor of the cost.
